# Enrico Lampis

> Web designer and builder. Codes every site by hand, no templates and no page builders, and ships custom high-end websites live within days. Twelve live sites for restaurants, shops and service businesses in Italy and Germany. Works remote and on-site.

## What this is

enricowebdigital.com is the portfolio and contact page of Enrico Lampis, an independent web designer and builder.

Every site is written by hand in clean, fast HTML tailored to the brand. No page builders, no themes, no off-the-shelf templates. Design judgement comes first; AI is used as execution, through a structured in-house Master-Prompt method, which is what makes fully custom work deliverable in days instead of months.

## Services

- **Hand-coded website** - every page coded by hand in clean, fast HTML tailored to the brand. No page builders, no themes.
- **Design and build with AI, done right** - a structured in-house Master-Prompt method pairs real design judgement with AI execution. Fully custom work delivered in days, not months.
- **Mobile-first launch** - designed for the phone first, built to load instantly, shipped live within days of starting.

Typical clients: restaurants, bakeries, bars, shops, florists and local service businesses that need a site which makes the right first impression on a phone.

## Beyond the browser

Enrico directed a self-publishing company, building and leading a 6 to 7 person team across writing, design, advertising and social proof, and scaling production from 3 to 12 or more active units. He designed the automation behind it: web-based pipelines that assemble content, slides, voice-over and video, publishing straight to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook.

## Builder Island

Enrico co-founded Builder Island with Alessandro: an in-person community of founders, builders and creators based in Sardinia. Not an online community. Weekly in-person sessions, building in public, mutual accountability. https://builderisland.club
